M. John Harrison Wins 2026 Booker Prize for 'The End of Everything'

British author M. John Harrison has won the 2026 Booker Prize for his novel 'The End of Everything'. Harrison, aged 81, is noted as the oldest winner of the prize, which carries a $95,000 award. Upon winning, Harrison commented that the world is becoming a 'weirder place'.
